body: At Nature’s Bounty®, we’re passionate about supporting your health—so you can live life to the fullest. As part of our commitment to women’s health and wellness, we’re proud to announce our second year partnering with Susan G. Komen® to raise breast cancer awareness, donate to help with breast cancer research and share ways to be proactive about breast health.
Want to help us make a difference? Read on for ways to get involved and shine brighter for the cure.

Susan G. Komen is the world’s largest nonprofit source of funding for the fight against breast cancer. Since 1982, the organization has invested nearly $3.6 billion in groundbreaking research, community health outreach, advocacy, and programs in more than 60 countries.

These efforts have helped reduce deaths from breast cancer by 43% since 1989. For the 300,000 Americans who will be diagnosed with breast cancer this year, Susan G. Komen shines a light of hope by continuing to find more discoveries, treatments, and advances in patient care.
Learn More About Breast Cancer and Susan G. Komen
Nature’s Bounty® is supporting Susan G. Komen in several exciting ways—and you can help!
For every bottle of Nature’s Bounty® Optimal Solutions® Hair, Skin & Nails Gummies purchased between 8/18/2023 to 11/19/2023, we will donate $0.50 to Susan G. Komen.^
Choose from our two popular Hair, Skin & Nails gummy products:
Hair, Skin & Nails Gummies provide you with the vital nutrients your body needs to support your natural beauty from within, including Biotin and the antioxidants Vitamin C and E.*
Advanced Hair, Skin & Nails Gummies are packed with 2x the amount of Biotin as our original gummy formula to support beautiful hair, glowing skin, and healthy nails.*
You’ll feel great knowing that each qualifying purchase helps to fund vital breast cancer research and support women and families impacted by this disease.
You can also grab your sneakers—and your favorite pink attire—and join us at the 3-Day Walk Series events or the NYC Race for the Cure event as Nature’s Bounty® Optimal Solutions® is sponsoring both!
3-Day Event: New England, August 18-20
3-Day Event: Denver, August 25-27
3-Day Event: Chicago, September 8-10
Race for the Cure: New York City, September 10 – Central Park
3-Day Event: Dallas – Ft. Worth, October 27-29
3-Day Event: San Diego, November 17-19
Sign up for a 3-Day Event!
Sign up for the NYC Race for the Cure!
Get the facts and spread the word.

Breast cancer is the second most common cancer among U.S. women, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Along with getting regular breast cancer screenings, some health and lifestyle changes can help to reduce your risk, including:
Maintaining a healthy weight
Limiting your alcohol consumption
Being physically active
Talking to your doctor about your risk factors

You can promote breast cancer awareness by getting the facts—and by encouraging friends and family to be proactive about breast health. Remember that early detection is important to catching breast cancer at a stage when the chances of survival are highest.

Together, we can help raise awareness about breast cancer and inspire more people to prioritize their breast health. Learn more about how Nature’s Bounty® and Susan G. Komen are partnering to shine brighter for the cure.

^ Donations are for each specially marked product sold in select retailers. Together with other program initiatives, Nature’s Bounty will make an aggregate guaranteed minimum donation of $300,000 to Komen, not to exceed $350,000.
